ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent efforts to combat Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the reevaluation of nearly 6,000 Medicaid service providers.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How effective have the state's efforts been in preventing and detecting Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant instances of Medicaid fraud and highlight the need for continued efforts to prevent and detect fraud in the state's Medicaid program.
